Aggregator listings carry figures but may not be used to state a fact. Requires a human to request a quote.
tuition_population: n/a — no tuition figure published for any population
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND as a tuition surcharge — no tuition price is published at all, so no differential can be confirmed. BUT a real, separately-priced non-EU COST IS published, for the 2026-2027 academic year: TAI's 'Planes de asesoría, Año Académico 2026-2027' charges 'Diploma y Máster Propio — Estudiantes extracomunitarios' EUR 560.00 + 21% IVA (= EUR 677.60) for visa advisory, foreigner ID documents, empadronamiento, private health insurance and bank-account help. The equivalent Grado/Máster Universitario packages are EUR 1,190.00 + IVA (extracomunitarios) and EUR 990.00 + IVA (comunitarios) — i.e. TAI does price non-EU students differently, but as an add-on service, not as tuition. Whether the plan is mandatory is not stated.
complementary_credits_required: NOT APPLICABLE AS A RUCT FACT — the title is not in RUCT, so there is no register row to quote (this is NOT 'NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT' for a registered title; the title simply is not registered). FOR THE APPLICANT: NOT FOUND. TAI's published admission route for a máster propio is only two steps — '1. ADMISIÓN: Solicita tu entrevista de admisión de forma presencial u online. 2. MATRICULACIÓN: Reserva tu plaza' — with no stated academic prerequisite, no complementos de formación, and no portfolio or audition requirement published. In practice the admission interview is the gate. Since it is a título propio there is also no complementos-de-formación mechanism in the legal sense. The candidate's 300 ECTS are irrelevant here: no advanced-standing or credit-recognition rule is published.
application_window_2027: NO DATED APPLICATION WINDOW — admission is by rolling interview with no published opening or closing date. The only date TAI publishes for this programme is the START date, stated verbatim as 'Inicio Octubre 2026' (i.e. the 2026-27 edition; NOT shifted forward to 2027). A promotional line '8% de descuento hasta el 28 de febrero' appears in the page source without a year and is not usable as a deadline. 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. Because a título propio has no Distrito Único preinscripción, there is no external calendar to fall back on either.
notes: ⚠️ THIS IS THE ONE NON-OFFICIAL PROGRAMME IN THIS BATCH OF NINE, and it is exactly the case the brief warns about: an official-looking 'Máster' at a university-affiliated school, marketed with a 'Titulación oficial por la Universidad Rey Juan Carlos' banner, that its own fact sheet labels 'Título Propio'. For a candidate ranking on funding and on PhD access this should be treated as disqualifying unless TAI confirms otherwise in writing. Independent evidence of non-officiality, three ways: (1) TAI's own 'Título Propio' label; (2) absence from RUCT while UNIR's genuinely official 'Máster Universitario en Producción Musical' (RUCT 3500676) is present; (3) TAI's own admission flow excludes máster propio from URJC Distrito Único preinscripción. Industry links are genuinely strong (Sony Music / Sony Music Publishing pitching and composition camp, MercaderLab, Sonobox; AVID Pro Tools 101/110 certification embedded), which is why the programme is attractive despite the status — record that trade-off rather than the status alone. NOT FOUND on this record: tuition, rates year, application dates, entry requirements.
